cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Back My Version
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to remember, repeat, and defend one shared version of events when questions begin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When the committee asks about the greenhouse, we were clearing up broken glass. Say that back to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were clearing up after your wheelbarrow hit it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with what we did inside the greenhouse. We don't need the entire approach route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: But if they ask how it broke, I'm telling them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then answer that question when it arrives. First, clearing up. Please stop putting the collision in every opening sentence.

reason: Use truthful eyewitness resistance to force A into supervising the order of a shared statement rather than denying the collision or pasting in expertise.
